first_year_admitting_units_text: Ten academic units accept first-year applications: Art & Design; Architecture & Urban Planning; Business; Education*; Engineering; Kinesiology; LSA; Music, Theatre & Dance; Nursing; and Pharmacy.
upper_level_admitting_units_text: Dental Hygiene, Information, Public Health, Public Policy, and Social Work are upper-level admitting units, meaning they accept applications from students already enrolled at Michigan during their first or sophomore year.
